contentText: Schools were evacuated across Italy on Wednesday following a series of hoax bomb threats, but Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said there was no "concrete danger". Similar hoax threats were reported in schools in Britain and Ireland, which reportedly prompted some evacuations in Scotland. Meloni said she had called a government meeting with security and intelligence chiefs for Wednesday to discuss the threats. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.
